observedHostedFailures.native: Hardware race not observed in normal job.
observedHostedFailures.sanitizer: Hardware race not observed for SIGUSR1; dependent signal check fails because the generator never queued the signal.

changes: Use separate available CPUs for tracer and tracee during race generation and restore both original affinity masks.
Prefer immediate interrupts with periodic yields, so the interrupt can actually race the synchronous trap.
Remove the premature 131072-iteration cap; keep the existing five-second real deadline.
Assert that the target CPU affinity is restored alongside the exact original hardware bank.
